intro: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Innkeeper Farley welcomes travelers with food, beds, and hearthstones. Well-liked and observant, he keeps misplaced mail and hears the troubles of those on the road.

p: Travelers bound for Stormwind, Westfall, and Duskwood find Innkeeper Farley behind the Lion's Pride Inn counter in Goldshire. He offers meals, ale, cheese, and a bed, and sets hearthstones for those who need one. With a welcoming hand and a sharp eye, Farley serves all who pass through this busy waystation and keeps order at the inn.
